Description.value: Makes Kitsune Shugyō's practice visible: a Practice tab with every attribute and crafting skill, its level or rank, a bar towards the next one, a Tired tag on tired attributes and, on hover, where the practice came from, and on the skills screen the attribute rows show the practice bar where the Buy button was. Does nothing without Kitsune Shugyō. Needs KitsuneUI. Contains a DLL: play with EAC off, and install on the server and every client.
